teaser: What do you do with a good line once it has formed in your head? The 3 wants it said out loud, to the room; the ISFJ in you wants to make sure the room is steady first — plates cleared, everyone fed, no one left out of the joke. Life path 3 is called the Creative, built for expression and lift; ISFJ is built for quiet upkeep, noticing what others miss. In you the wit doesn't perform so much as it serves: a story told to put someone at ease, warmth with a job to do.
